courses.name: Avalon Golf Course
courses.notes: 9 holes, par 32, 1,700 m off the ladies tees. Lengths in metres; tee sets: ladies (ladies is the primary: the first men's set the card lists, the only set the source shows). No handicap rating stored: the source shows none. Cross-check: Hole19 refused automated reading before this card could be compared with a second source; check it against the club's card. Hole19 shows a single 'ladies' set of nine holes played twice (par 32 a nine, 64 for 18); no men's lengths were found. Hole19 reviews call it a 9-hole course. Hole19's stroke index on the nine is the odd numbers of an 18-hole index (9, 1, 15, ...), so none is stored.
